about: Every census row that DISAGREES today, held by identity and with the figures it measured (WP-14.1). tests/test_svg_census.py holds the live set EQUAL to this map: a new disagreement fails, a fixed one must be removed from here in the same commit as its fix, and one whose figures moved must be re-pinned by a commit that says why. Never add or edit an entry to make a build green; an entry changes only when the census measures something new, and the commit says what.
